# Hart Ops

> Hart Ops is Tom Hart's profit-advisory practice for $1M–$5M marketing and creative agencies. The site explains his 12-step philosophy for fixing people and process leaks, shares client results, and provides a contact form for prospective clients.

## About Tom Hart

Tom Hart is a profit advisor with 20 years inside marketing and creative agencies, covering operations, finance, and project management. He helps owner-operators move from high-stress firefighting to 20% margins by design. He previously ran a direct-to-consumer business in the USA for over a decade. He builds [VERA](https://getvera.site) — a Slack-native time-tracking and financial-intelligence assistant for agencies — and hosts *The Irreplaceable Professional* podcast.

## What Hart Ops does

- Identifies and fixes people and process leaks in agencies billing $1M–$5M annually
- Installs the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) as standard
- Teaches Labor Efficiency Ratio (LER) as the core profitability metric
- Builds documented processes so the business is sellable
- Coaches owners out of the Do/Own/Risk trap and into Command-by-Intent leadership

## The 12-step philosophy

1. Face Reality — accept things as they are, with brutal honesty
2. The Do, Own, and Risk Trap — trust the team, play one role
3. Operating Values vs Core Values — decision-making framework over values framework
4. Run a Business You Could Sell — asset value grows over time
5. The Talent Siphon — labor advantage without overpaying
6. Command by Intent — people make decisions without the owner in the room
7. The Daily Bookend — win one day at a time
8. Mistakes Mean Progress — calm in a storm, learning company
9. Systems Thinking — humans better than AI at the human parts
10. Labor Efficiency Ratio (LER) — dollars out vs dollars in
11. Junior Talent Is Your Future — seniors who teach juniors
12. What Winning Looks Like — progress over perfection

## Documented results

- North Street Creative: +25% revenue, +122% Labor Efficiency, +40% profit, owner salary brought to market, line of credit paid off
- p3 Maine: +30% labor efficiency immediately; staff reporting higher job satisfaction and intent to stay
